result.instructions: HerculeRadar watches public posts about a brand and classifies them. Typical flow: list_monitors to see what is watched, list_mentions to read what people said, get_mention_analytics to summarise a period, create_monitor to start watching something new. Every tool returns { data, meta }. Page lists with the returned nextCursor. Read https://herculeradar.com/llms-full.txt for the full contract.
